reference: torch.cumsum(x, dim) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: x is fed as a permuted view: uploaded with its dims reversed, then permuted back. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator). f16/bf16 accumulate in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8).
